scope: Entire new evidence subtree before inventory and hash-manifest generation; all UTF-8 evidence/logs/JSON, all 612 original JPEG files and all 612 OCR texts.
visualReview: All screenshot thumbnails inspected through 26 contact sheets, with focal findings reviewed at full size. See screenshot-review.json.
publicationContent: Synthetic business selectors, local test database name, correlation IDs, public commit SHAs and presence-only environment booleans retained. No private environment values or raw request headers are published.
sanitizationApplied: Production/build/SQL/performance logs retain only sanitized workspace placeholders or approved event fields.
Session cleanup proof contains aggregate counts and hashes, without raw session IDs or tokens.
limitations: Pattern/literal checks and OCR are fallible. PASS means no matching publication-sensitive content found in this recorded scan, not a universal guarantee.
